question: Should OpenClaw add marketplace-watch state to the shared SQLite schema now, or should this notification capability remain outside core until its product and storage ownership are explicitly approved?
rationale: This is a new durable product capability and a global schema-version change; repository policy requires explicit acceptance rather than treating it as an autonomous implementation detail.

options.title: Approve shared-state watches
options.body: Accept the v4 shared-state design after reviewing upgrade and retention behavior, then require real command-flow proof before merge.

options.title: Defer or externalize the capability
options.body: Keep the current feed inspection surface and move watch notifications to a separately owned plugin or future approved design.

recommendation.title: Approve shared-state watches
recommendation.body: Accept the v4 shared-state design after reviewing upgrade and retention behavior, then require real command-flow proof before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: The available release provenance makes this the best low-confidence routing candidate for the required product and persistent-state decision.
